اجلعبوا (form IVq)
# اِجْلَعَبُّوا (ijlaʕabbū) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕab.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# اِجْلَعِبُّوا (ijlaʕibbū) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕib.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
